LanguageData.MS_StorageCore.label: storage control core
LanguageData.MS_StorageCore.description: Manages storage units connected by storage conduits, with shared item filters and storage priority. Colonists deliver items to connected storage receivers, and the core distributes them to storage units. Ordinary hauling cannot withdraw items from units; dedicated outlets can supply their supported needs. Changing the filter does not remove stored items. Each network supports one control core.\n\nUse View items on the core to select items and quantities for withdrawal onto the ground around it.
LanguageData.MS_StorageReceiver.label: storage receiver
LanguageData.MS_StorageReceiver.description: Receives hauled items for distribution to storage units by the connected control core. Provides 10 temporary stack slots, using the core's item filter and storage priority.\n\nStops accepting deliveries when the network cannot operate or has no available capacity. Items already delivered remain at the receiving position. Waiting items have not entered a storage unit and remain ordinary ground items. The receiver itself conducts storage connections.
LanguageData.MS_StorageFoodOutlet.label: food outlet
LanguageData.MS_StorageFoodOutlet.description: Supplies food from connected storage for eating, packing meals, feeding patients and babies, delivering prisoner meals, and taming and training animals. Colony animals can also collect food here. Gathering meals and food binges follow their own behavior rules. Supplies feedstock for nutrient paste hoppers, growth vats and biosculpter pods.\n\nThe collector must reach the outlet. Food is selected for the actual eater or equipment. Hopper storage priority must exceed core priority. If the outlet cannot supply food, ordinary sources remain available. The outlet holds no items itself and does not supply crafting or caravan loading.
LanguageData.MS_StorageUnit.label: storage unit
LanguageData.MS_StorageUnit.description: A storage unit with 64 stack slots. Items follow normal stacking rules and suspend regular updates while stored. Disconnecting the unit does not erase its contents. The unit itself conducts storage connections without a separate conduit underneath.
LanguageData.MS_StorageConduit.label: storage conduit
LanguageData.MS_StorageConduit.description: Connects storage control cores and storage units through cardinally adjacent cells. Can run under buildings that permit conduits underneath. Storage conduits form a separate network and do not transmit electricity.
